identity.name: MAO
identity.claim: Systems that have to be right, not just run.
identity.lede: Research infrastructure, agent orchestration, reverse engineering and security research. Most of it is private; this is the index.

slots.name: research infrastructure
slots.lead: Backtest, replay and live call the same process_bar(). Divergence is impossible by construction, not merely unlikely.
points: walk-forward, frozen out-of-sample, FDR correction
drift and out-of-distribution kill-switches
local-GPU-first, burst to cloud when the queue justifies it

slots.name: agent orchestration
slots.lead: A private control plane for multi-agent workflows. The hard part is surviving a crash mid-call, not calling a model.
points: transactional queue: atomic claim, idempotent enqueue, bounded retry
budget ceiling checked before a billable call
append-only hash-chained journal, checkpoint + replay
fail-safe autonomy: an unlisted transition stops and asks

slots.name: reverse engineering
slots.lead: Obfuscated and virtualized managed binaries, packed interpreters, protocol layers.
points: a protector's bytecode VM, partially mapped
blocked without an execution oracle — and written down as blocked
guessing is not the job

slots.name: security research
slots.lead: Written authorization, defined scope, rules of engagement. Any one missing and the engagement is suspended.
points: PTES · OWASP WSTG / ASVS · CVSS v3.1
timestamped evidence, prioritized remediation
targets, findings, evidence and tooling stay private — permanently

slots.name: systems & automation
slots.lead: The boring parts that save you.
points: a pre-commit gate that blocks any commit regressing a known fact
markdown is truth, the index is cache — burn it, lose nothing
append-only ADRs; rejections kept with the evidence that killed them
SLO reporting returns unavailable rather than inventing a metric

slots.name: applied ML
slots.lead: Reinforcement learning under non-stationarity, ensembles over point estimates, drift and OOD detection as a safety layer rather than a metric.

slots.name: frontend
slots.lead: The same component across six framework boundaries must behave identically, not merely look similar.
points: reference checked byte-for-byte in CI
clean-install consumer builds tested end to end
accessibility asserted in a real browser, not claimed in a readme

Including a banking context: review, traceability, changes explainable long after they shipped.
